title: AO/287/1999 of REV.ERIC MASIH and ANOTHER Vs WORLD PRE-BYTERIAN MISSIONS INC

paras.text:
A.O. No. 116 of 2004
Hon. Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Shri Umesh Kalakoti, Advocate for the appellant.
 This is restoration application MCC No. 1000 of 2008, for restoration
of Second Appeal (defective) No. 27 of 2007, which was dismissed for want
of prosecution on 22.07.2008.
 Heard.
 Having considered the ground mentioned in the affidavit
accompanying the application, the restoration application is allowed.
 The appellant is allowed one more chance to take steps by Tuesday
i.e. 21.10.2008.
